Visitor skips superscript from output

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_superscript(self, ctx, text):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return "skip"
    html = "<p>The equation x<sup>3</sup> + y<sup>3</sup> = z<sup>3</sup> has no solutions.</p>"
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
